title: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity

entities.name: Akul
entities.description: The dragon leader of the Hellspurs, who burns a copper mine and kills its overseer while hunting for the stolen key.

entities.name: Hellspurs
entities.description: Akul's outlaw gang, sent to find the shapeshifting thief.

entities.name: Mine overseer
entities.description: A Sterling Company mine overseer who tells Akul about the theft and is killed by him.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A fae shapeshifter who leads the crew and is reunited with his son Kellan, and who shows little concern for the lives of others.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A young fae and Oko's son who helps the crew but wants to save the train's passengers.

entities.name: Annie Flash
entities.description: A sharpshooter on Oko's crew who rescues Nolan and Umezawa on Fortune and helps Kellan save the passengers.

entities.name: Fortune
entities.description: Annie's horse-like companion who carries the rescued men.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon on Oko's crew.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: A warlock who examines the key and warns it could unleash another Phyrexia.

entities.name: Satoru Umezawa
entities.description: A thief on the crew with a lockpicking device, wounded by a thunder blast on the train.

entities.name: Gisa
entities.description: A necromancer who raises zombies on the train, in constant conflict with her brother Geralf.

entities.name: Geralf
entities.description: A necromancer, Gisa's brother, who describes himself as a stitcher.

entities.name: Eriette
entities.description: A witch on the crew who dislikes Kellan.

entities.name: Malcolm
entities.description: A winged siren who does reconnaissance for the crew.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: A goblin explosives expert who blows up the bridge.

entities.name: Tinybones
entities.description: A skeleton thief on the crew.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A shadowy planeswalker who hired the crew and created the telepathic link; Kellan says they attacked his home.

entities.name: Nolan
entities.description: An Outcaster artifact expert from the territories, captured from a Sterling train by Oko's crew.

entities.name: Bertram Graywater
entities.description: The Sterling Company leader searching for the stolen key.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: A person Kellan says Ashiok manipulated into turning evil.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker whose relationship with Kellan was damaged.

entities.name: Alyse
entities.description: Kellan's mother.

entities.name: Sterling Company
entities.description: The powerful company whose guards pursue the crew.

entities.name: The key
entities.description: An ancient artifact, older than Thran or Phyrexian make, that unlocks the vault and may be more dangerous than a key.

entities.name: Tarnation
entities.description: The town built by the Hellspurs near the vault, which the crew cannot yet locate.

entities.name: The train to Prosperity
entities.description: A Sterling Company train carrying Nolan that goes over a destroyed bridge.

entities.name: Prosperity
entities.description: The Sterling Company's city, the train's destination.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The invading force Kaervek fears the artifact could unleash again.

events.summary: Akul interrogates a mine overseer, learning of a shapeshifting fae thief, and sends the Hellspurs after him.
events.quote: It was some shapeshifting fae from another plane.

events.summary: Akul kills the overseer with his tail stinger.
events.quote: Akul whipped the barbed, venomous stinger on the end of his tail into the man's gut

events.summary: Oko tells Kellan he is glad to have met him and promises to teach him about his heritage.
events.quote: Now that we've finally been reunited, I can teach you so much about your true heritage.

events.summary: Kellan recognizes Ashiok, says they attacked his home and made Rowan Kenrith turn evil, but Oko tells him to trust him instead.
events.quote: They made Rowan Kenrith turn—well, evil!

events.summary: Kaervek reports that the artifact is not Thran or Phyrexian, and warns it could unleash another Phyrexia.
events.quote: You could be unleashing another Phyrexia on the Multiverse.

events.summary: Annie names an Outcaster named Nolan who can read the artifact, and Vraska says he is on a train to Prosperity under Sterling guard.
events.quote: "The man in question is currently on a train to Prosperity, escorted by Sterling mercenaries."

events.summary: Kellan reluctantly agrees to help plan the capture after Oko promises no innocents will be harmed.
events.quote: "I promise that no innocents will be harmed."

events.summary: Kellan and Oko, disguised as Sterling guards, ride the train with Umezawa while the rest of the crew watches over a telepathic link.
events.quote: The moment Oko's voice pressed into Kellan's mind, he flinched.

events.summary: Gisa raises zombies too early, and Sterling guards find Kellan, Oko and Umezawa in the luggage car.
events.quote: "She raised the zombies too early," Geralf groaned.

events.summary: A fight in the luggage car leaves Umezawa wounded and two guards down.
events.quote: Oko moved swiftly, freeing a curved knife from his belt.

events.summary: Oko overrules Kellan about helping Umezawa and orders Annie to blow up the bridge.
The bridge explodes but the train does not slow, because the zombies have reached the conductor.
events.quote: The explosion was instant, echoing through the train walls and making the floor shake.

events.summary: Kellan and Oko cross the train roof, are attacked by Sterling guards, and are saved by Gisa's reanimated dead.
events.quote: Gray rotted arms closed around the guard's shoulders, and her weapon clattered to the ground.

events.summary: Oko disguises himself as a guard to lure away Nolan's escorts, and he and Kellan toss them off the train, capturing Nolan.
Annie arrives on Fortune and carries Nolan and Umezawa away from the train.
events.quote: Annie steered Fortune toward safety and broke into a fearless gallop

events.summary: Oko jumps off, abandoning the passengers, while Kellan follows and tries to stop the train with his vines.
events.quote: He leapt, tumbling across the sand with unsteady grace.

events.summary: Oko abandons Kellan as he struggles to hold the train at the cliff edge as the Sterling army approaches.
events.quote: With a final glance, he turned his back on Kellan and fled for the hills.

events.summary: Annie returns and holds off the Sterling riders while the passengers jump from the train.
events.quote: each of them nervously jumping for the desert floor before fleeing as far from the train as possible.

events.summary: Kellan releases his vines and the train plunges off the cliff and explodes; Annie and Kellan escape on Fortune.
events.quote: Kellan released his vines with a gasp, and the train shot over the edge of the cliff

relations.quote: Akul's gaze snapped to the Hellspurs. "Find him. Now ."

relations.note: Akul stabs the overseer with his stinger.
relations.quote: By the time he hit the ground, he was already gone.
Still, he followed his father downstairs
"The only thing I don't have patience for is you , brother," she said.

relations.note: The two siblings are at war with each other.
relations.quote: Gisa and Geralf stood on opposite sides of the room, clearly at war with one another.

relations.note: Kellan says Ashiok attacked his home.
relations.quote: They attacked my home and manipulated people into doing their bidding.

relations.note: Kellan says Ashiok made Rowan turn evil.
relations.quote: They made Rowan Kenrith turn—well, evil!

relations.note: Annie rides Fortune to rescue the others.
relations.quote: Annie appeared with Fortune, galloping alongside the train.
